messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert created for us-west-2a - inference request errors and connection resets; pages sent to oncall.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty triggered: rota=infra-sre, urgency=high, runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/snat-port-exhaustion

dana-sre: I'm on it. seeing 15% 502/504 from our hosted inference tier originating from us-west-2a. latency p95 up from 80ms -> 420ms over last 10m.

liam-eng: I can see a spike in TCP retries on the nodes in us-west-2a. dmesg on node g5-az1a-238 shows repeated tx timeouts, but more suspicious: many ephemeral port errors in our proxy logs (connection pool errors: no available SNAT ports).

maria-support: Customer impact: ~12 active customers reporting degraded responses; a few customers on shared hosted plans see repeated request timeouts. No Dedicated customers on reserved pools affected (confirmed).

kris-ops: Confirming NAT gateway metrics: us-west-2a natgw-3b shows SNAT port utilization at ~98%, source ports exhausted for ~30s windows. CloudWatch shows many ephemeral connections with short TTL.

liam-eng: Reproduced locally: run: 
  # list conntrack entries
  sudo conntrack -L | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l
Result: ~1.2M entries on affected NAT route table.

liam-eng: Hypothesis: sudden reduction in upstream keepalive reuse + autoscaler creating many short-lived pods -> many outbound connections -> NAT SNAT port exhaustion -> ephemeral connection failures from inference workers to external services (model stores, tokenizers, telemetry).

dana-sre: Rolling mitigations:
- Mark us-west-2a as degraded in traffic router so new requests avoid AZ (traffic-router set-policy --az us-west-2a --weight 0.1).
- Enable cross-AZ fallbacks for hosted: traffic-router enable-fallback us-west-2 -> instant.
- Increase worker keepalive pools temporarily: apply patch to inference-proxy config to increase keepalive reuse and enable connection pooling.

kris-ops: While routing changes propagate, I'm creating a second NAT Gateway in the same AZ and enabling Elastic IP failover to pre-warm additional SNAT capacity. Creating natgw-3c now (this takes ~1-2m to attach).

maria-support: Noting customers receiving timeouts are mostly short-lived burst jobs (batch embedding calls). Reached out to top 3 affected customers with standard incident notification (initial).

liam-eng: Patch to inference-proxy applied to 50% of edge pods in us-west-2a (canary). Config snippet: 

  http {
    keepalive_timeout 65;
    keepalive_requests 1000;
    upstream_pool_size 1024;
  }

Patch reduced new outbound connection creation on canary nodes (observed).

pagerduty-bot: Oncall handoff scheduled in 45m -> next: liam-eng (taking on-call at 14:40 UTC).

dana-sre: Status update (T+18m): NAT pre-warm in flight; traffic-router policy applied - new traffic to us-west-2a reduced to 10%. Error rate dropped from 15% -> 5% but still elevated. ETA for full remediation 25-40m depending on natgw readiness.

kris-ops: natgw-3c active and in-service. Elastic IPs attached. CloudWatch SNAT port utilization dropped to ~70% after EIP attach + route propagation.

liam-eng: Observability note: KV cache warmups for some models timed out earlier because of the SNAT failures; we're re-triggering kvcache regen on a subset of nodes to avoid cache-miss storms (kvcache-regen --model gptx-8b --subset small).

maria-support: Customer comms: Sent second update to affected customers: we have partial mitigation (routing + natgw scale) and working on full return to normal. Next update in 30m or on state change.

dana-sre: Handoff: I'm going offline for 20m to join an exec call. @liam-eng you're the active responder. Key items for you: keep traffic-router at reduced weight until SNAT metrics stable <60%; confirm no regressing of latency; follow up on kvcache regen and watchdog alerts.

liam-eng: Acknowledged. I'll keep an eye on 502/504 and ensure canary to full roll is safe. Starting full rollout of proxy keepalive change if errors stay <6% for 10m.

kris-ops: Suggestion: add temporary egress NAT mapping rule in VPC to route telemetry endpoints via dedicated NAT with long-lived flows to reduce short-lived ephemeral port churn. I'll open ticket to make this persistent if it helps long-term.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: Incident channel pinned with runbook and customer impact template. Next scheduled update at +30m.

liam-eng: 10m check: errors holding at ~4.7%, p95 latency 160ms. Proceeding with staged rollout to 100% of edge pods in us-west-2a.

maria-support: Updated customers with improved metrics and ETA. No escalation requests yet.

liam-eng: Rollout complete. Post-rollout metrics: errors 1.2% (baseline ~0.7%), SNAT utilization 45%, latency p95 95ms. Closing mitigation phase.

dana-sre: Great work. Incident declared resolved for customer-impacting outages. We'll keep channel open for 1h to monitor. Next steps for RCA:
- Confirm root cause: combination of short-lived connection surge + insufficient NAT pre-warm + pooling defaults.
- Follow-up action items: automate NAT pre-warm for expected burst, increase default keepalive/pool sizes for edge proxy, add alert for conntrack growth, consider egress-path partitioning for high-churn workloads.

maria-support: Post-incident summary draft will go out to customers tomorrow AM. I'll include timeline and actions.

kris-ops: Filing postmortem ticket: PM-INC-3532104321. Assigning follow-ups to infra and networking.

incident-bot: Incident P1 -> transitioned to post-incident review.
